subject: Request: Pen test evidence handoff & exec summary sanitization
messages:
From: Alex Santos <alex.santos@nodewave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: legal@nodewave.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full pen-test + exec summary (SIG follow-up)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. NodeWave completed the SIG/CAIQ scan and the security team has one last ask before we close the control: can we get the most recent penetration test report and an executive summary that we can share with our CTO and compliance lead?

We're sensitive to PII and internal hostnames. Ideally we'd get: 1) an exec summary redacted for internal hostnames/IPs, 2) the full report under an NDA or secure viewer for our security reviewers, and 3) a short CSV with the sample evidence (screenshots / PoC IDs) for our audit log.

If there's an engineering remediations list you can share today (even high level), that would help accelerate our procurement signoff. Also let me know if you require an NDA addendum specific to penetration evidence.

We want to keep this moving — target is to complete review by next Friday (2026-07-09).

Thanks,
Alex Santos
Security Ops Lead, NodeWave Health
alex.santos@nodewave.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: none

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Santos <alex.santos@nodewave.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test + exec summary (SIG follow-up)

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the three artifacts you listed, and I want to propose a minimal sharing path that balances your reviewers' needs with our obligations to third parties:

Options we can offer immediately:
- Redacted executive summary (PDF): we redact hostnames, internal account names, and any vendor-specific PoC code. Watermarked as "For NodeWave Security Review — Not for redistribution."
- Full report (zip): available via our secure viewer for up to 5 named reviewers for a time-limited window (7 days). View-only with per-user watermarking and download disabled.
- Evidence sample (CSV): a sanitized CSV mapping PoC IDs to remediation status and non-sensitive artefact references (no raw PoC scripts).

Two compliance items to note:
1) Some third-party bug bounty findings include author-attribution that we can't fully remove without consent. We can provide a redaction matrix that lists candidate carve-outs.
2) We require an NDA addendum for evidence-level artifacts (the exec summary standard NDA covers the report but not raw evidence). If NodeWave legal can e-sign the addendum I'll route it for countersignature.

Quick questions: who will be the named reviewers? Legal? CTO? Please list emails so we can provision viewer accounts. Also confirm whether your reviewers need downloadable artifacts or view-only.

I'll draft the addendum and a redaction matrix and loop in Karthik for any high-risk items. Target: I'll get the redacted exec summary to you today for initial review and the secure viewer link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering — Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: redaction-guidelines-v1.txt (see summarized below)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test + exec summary (SIG follow-up)

Folks — quick note from security/infosec ops on carving the evidence set:

- High-risk items (RCE PoCs, working exploit code): not shareable outside secure viewer. If NodeWave requires playback, we require an explicit controlled demonstration
- Medium-risk (config leaks, creds in logs): shareable if redacted and agreed in matrix
- Low-risk (outdated library findings, weak cipher configs): can be included in the redacted exec summary and CSV sample

Proposed redaction process (2 steps):
1) Automated pass: mask IPs/hostnames and remove raw PoC attachments
2) Manual review: security engineer (Karthik/Marissa) performs a spot-check on items flagged by the matrix before release

I'll attach a thin "redaction matrix" (spreadsheet) and a short checklist for the viewer provisioning. If NodeWave provides the reviewer emails I will pre-provision the secure viewer tokens and add watermarks.

Also note: if Legal requests the full unredacted archive for forensic purposes we will require a signed escrow agreement and evidence-handling SOP.

-Karthik
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redaction_matrix.csv (we'll generate), evidence-handling-sop.md

From: Alex Santos <alex.santos@nodewave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: legal@nodewave.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full pen-test + exec summary (SIG follow-up)

Kimberly / Karthik — appreciate the fast follow-up. NodeWave agrees to the secure viewer, watermarking, and the two-step redaction process.

Reviewers (please provision view-only accounts for these):
- jennifer.mills@nodewave.com (CTO)
- marcus.lee@nodewave.com (Head of Security)
- legal@nodewave.com (procurement legal)

Download disabled is fine. We can sign the NDA addendum — legal@nodewave.com will complete the DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

Request: can you deliver an initial redacted exec summary (PDF) and the sanitized CSV sample by COB tomorrow (2026-07-02)? If possible include a one-paragraph remediation status for the top five findings (severity + ETA). That will let us move forward with procurement.

If you need an additional reviewer after provisioning we can add one more (total of 5 max).

Thanks — looking forward to the link and the exec summary.

Alex
Security Ops Lead, NodeWave Health

> Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can support the three artifacts you listed...
